adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath` was changed to `type.replace('_', '-')` before checking `ADMIN_MODELS`. This only converts the first underscore, so a model name containing multiple underscores (e.g. `site_text_override`) would become `site-text_override` and fail to match a dasherized admin model key, causing it to use the non-admin base path. However, in this diff the only relevant types (`embeddable_host` / `site_customization`) have at most one underscore, so no concrete breakage is demonstrated here; it’s a real robustness/edge-case issue introduced by this change rather than a currently verifiable failure.
